name: MC - Work Todo Writeback
purpose: Apply bounded Mission Control changes through the work user's Microsoft To Do connection.

trigger.type: When an HTTP request is received
trigger.security: Tenant authentication when available; otherwise protect and rotate the signed trigger URL.

update.note: Map only fields present under fields; do not replace omitted values with null. dueDateTime is the connector's date-time string input, not the pull response's dateTime/timeZone object.

delete.condition: @and(equals(triggerBody()?['allowDelete'], true), equals(parameters('MC Work Todo Allow Delete'), true))
delete.onFalse: Append skipped result with errorCode DELETE_DISABLED. MC must not acknowledge this item. The environment parameter defaults to false and is independent of the request envelope.

actions.name: Append_result
actions.note: Configure run-after for success and failure so every input receives one result.

actions.name: Respond
actions.statusCode: 200 when all succeeded or skipped; 207 when any failed
